mission_06: Compute S = softmax(X @ W_assign, axis=1) to get a soft assignment of each node to each cluster
The coarsened adjacency A_pooled = S.T @ A @ S gives the connectivity between clusters, where each entry represents the expected number of edges between cluster pairs
Entropy loss = -sum(S * log(S + eps)) / (N * K) encourages each node to belong to a single cluster rather than being spread across many
